# Retail CoD 1.1d dedicated server, votes called and cast by three clients.
# map mp_carentan, g_gametype tdm, dedicated 1, sv_maxclients 8, sv_pure 0. Captured 2026-10-14 with
# tools/run_server.sh mp_carentan +set g_gametype tdm +set rconPassword pw and three probes started
# 0.15 s apart: vcod --net-probe --probe-name Able --probe-team axis, --probe-name Baker
# --probe-team allies, --probe-name Charlie --probe-team spectator, each with the --probe-say lines
# below (--probe-secs 60), and the two rcon lines sent by hand at about the times given.
# !say <client> <secs> <command>: a client command at its second after that client's gamestate.
# !rcon <secs> <command>: a console command, on Able's clock.
# !cmd <client> <line>: what that client got, in arrival order: every e line, n, and each
# change to configstrings 15..18 as `d <index> <value>`; configstring 15's value is written as
# +<value minus the serverTime of the snapshot that brought it>, control bytes as \xNN.
!say Able 8.0 callvote
!cmd Able e "GAME_INVALIDVOTESTRING"
!cmd Able e "GAME_VOTECOMMANDSARE\x15 map_restart, map_rotate, map <mapname>, g_gametype <typename>, typemap <typename> <mapname>, kick <player>, clientkick <clientnum>"
!say Able 9.0 callvote kick Nobody
!cmd Able e "GAME_CLIENTNOTONSERVER"
!say Able 10.0 callvote typemap tdm
!cmd Able e "GAME_TYPEMAP_NOCHANGE"
!say Able 11.0 callvote g_gametype bogus
!cmd Able e "GAME_INVALIDGAMETYPE"
!say Able 12.0 callvote clientkick 9
!cmd Able e "GAME_CLIENTNOTONSERVER"
!say Able 13.0 callvote kick baker
!cmd Able e "GAME_CALLEDAVOTE\x15Able"
!cmd Able d 15 +29950
!cmd Able d 16 GAME_VOTE_KICK\x15(1)Baker
!cmd Able d 17 1
!cmd Able d 18 0
!say Able 14.0 callvote map_restart
!cmd Able e "GAME_VOTEALREADYINPROGRESS"
!say Able 15.0 vote yes
!cmd Able e "GAME_VOTEALREADYCAST"
!cmd Able d 18 1
!cmd Able e "GAME_VOTEFAILED"
!cmd Able d 15 
!say Able 19.0 callvote clientkick 1
!cmd Able e "GAME_CALLEDAVOTE\x15Able"
!cmd Able d 15 +29950
!cmd Able d 18 0
!cmd Able d 18 1
!cmd Able e "GAME_VOTEFAILED"
!cmd Able d 15 
!say Able 22.0 callvote map_restart
!cmd Able e "GAME_CALLEDAVOTE\x15Able"
!cmd Able d 15 +29950
!cmd Able d 16 GAME_VOTE_MAPRESTART
!cmd Able d 18 0
!cmd Able d 18 1
!cmd Able e "GAME_VOTEFAILED"
!cmd Able d 15 
!say Able 25.0 callvote map_restart
!cmd Able e "GAME_CALLEDAVOTE\x15Able"
!cmd Able d 15 +29950
!cmd Able d 18 0
!cmd Able d 17 2
!cmd Able e "GAME_VOTEPASSED"
!cmd Able d 15 
!cmd Able n
!say Able 33.0 vote yes
!cmd Able e "GAME_NOVOTEINPROGRESS"
!say Able 35.0 callvote map_rotate
!cmd Able e "GAME_CALLEDAVOTE\x15Able"
!cmd Able d 15 +29950
!cmd Able d 16 GAME_VOTE_NEXTMAP
!cmd Able d 17 1
!cmd Able n
!say Able 46.0 vote yes
!cmd Able e "GAME_NOVOTEINPROGRESS"
!say Able 53.0 callvote map_restart
!cmd Able e "GAME_VOTINGNOTENABLED"
!cmd Baker e "GAME_CALLEDAVOTE\x15Able"
!cmd Baker d 15 +29950
!cmd Baker d 16 GAME_VOTE_KICK\x15(1)Baker
!cmd Baker d 17 1
!cmd Baker d 18 0
!say Baker 16.0 vote no
!cmd Baker e "GAME_VOTECAST"
!cmd Baker d 18 1
!cmd Baker e "GAME_VOTEFAILED"
!cmd Baker d 15 
!cmd Baker e "GAME_CALLEDAVOTE\x15Able"
!cmd Baker d 15 +29950
!cmd Baker d 18 0
!say Baker 20.0 vote Yes
!cmd Baker e "GAME_VOTECAST"
!cmd Baker d 18 1
!cmd Baker e "GAME_VOTEFAILED"
!cmd Baker d 15 
!cmd Baker e "GAME_CALLEDAVOTE\x15Able"
!cmd Baker d 15 +29950
!cmd Baker d 16 GAME_VOTE_MAPRESTART
!cmd Baker d 18 0
!say Baker 23.0 vote 1
!cmd Baker e "GAME_VOTECAST"
!cmd Baker d 18 1
!cmd Baker e "GAME_VOTEFAILED"
!cmd Baker d 15 
!cmd Baker e "GAME_CALLEDAVOTE\x15Able"
!cmd Baker d 15 +29950
!cmd Baker d 18 0
!say Baker 26.0 vote y
!cmd Baker e "GAME_VOTECAST"
!cmd Baker d 17 2
!cmd Baker e "GAME_VOTEPASSED"
!cmd Baker d 15 
!cmd Baker n
!cmd Baker e "GAME_CALLEDAVOTE\x15Able"
!cmd Baker d 15 +29950
!cmd Baker d 16 GAME_VOTE_NEXTMAP
!cmd Baker d 17 1
!say Baker 37.0 callvote g_gametype dm
!cmd Baker e "GAME_VOTEALREADYINPROGRESS"
!cmd Baker n
!say Baker 47.0 vote no
!cmd Baker e "GAME_NOVOTEINPROGRESS"
!cmd Charlie e "GAME_CALLEDAVOTE\x15Able"
!cmd Charlie d 15 +29950
!cmd Charlie d 16 GAME_VOTE_KICK\x15(1)Baker
!cmd Charlie d 17 1
!cmd Charlie d 18 0
!say Charlie 15.5 vote yes
!cmd Charlie e "GAME_NOSPECTATORVOTE"
!cmd Charlie d 18 1
!cmd Charlie e "GAME_VOTEFAILED"
!cmd Charlie d 15 
!say Charlie 18.0 callvote map_restart
!cmd Charlie e "GAME_NOSPECTATORCALLVOTE"
!cmd Charlie e "GAME_CALLEDAVOTE\x15Able"
!cmd Charlie d 15 +29950
!cmd Charlie d 18 0
!cmd Charlie d 18 1
!cmd Charlie e "GAME_VOTEFAILED"
!cmd Charlie d 15 
!cmd Charlie e "GAME_CALLEDAVOTE\x15Able"
!cmd Charlie d 15 +29950
!cmd Charlie d 16 GAME_VOTE_MAPRESTART
!cmd Charlie d 18 0
!cmd Charlie d 18 1
!cmd Charlie e "GAME_VOTEFAILED"
!cmd Charlie d 15 
!cmd Charlie e "GAME_CALLEDAVOTE\x15Able"
!cmd Charlie d 15 +29950
!cmd Charlie d 18 0
!cmd Charlie d 17 2
!cmd Charlie e "GAME_VOTEPASSED"
!cmd Charlie d 15 
!cmd Charlie n
!cmd Charlie e "GAME_CALLEDAVOTE\x15Able"
!cmd Charlie d 15 +29950
!cmd Charlie d 16 GAME_VOTE_NEXTMAP
!cmd Charlie d 17 1
!cmd Charlie n
!rcon 40.0 map_restart
!rcon 50.0 g_allowvote 0
